                 ERCOT Monthly
               Operational Overview
                   (September 2026)


                     ERCOT Public
                    October 16, 2026
 PUBLIC   Highlights, Records and Notifications

     • ERCOT set a new record of 86,647 MW* for the month of September on 9/12/2026; This is
       6,698 MW more than the September 2025 demand of 79,949 MW on 9/04/2025.

     • ERCOT issued 3 Advisories:
         •   ERCOT Issued an Advisory on 09/15/2026: ERCOT has postponed the deadline for the posting of the DAM solution for
             Operating Day 09/16/2026 due to long run time.
         •   ERCOT Issued an Advisory on 09/28/2026: ERCOT has postponed the deadline for the posting of the DAM solution for
             Operating Day 09/29/2026 due to long run time.
         •   ERCOT Issued an Advisory on 09/29/2026: ERCOT has postponed the deadline for the posting of the DAM solution for
             Operating Day 09/30/2026 due to long run time.

 PUBLIC       Planning Summary

         •   ERCOT is tracking 1,874 active generation interconnection requests totaling 453,782 MW as of
             September 30. This includes 155,123 MW of solar, 49,746 MW of wind, 162,580 MW of battery,
             and 81,034 MW of gas projects; 175 projects were categorized as inactive, up from 168 in August.

         •   ERCOT is currently reviewing proposed transmission improvements with a total estimated cost of
             $22.699 billion as of September 30, 2026.

         •   Transmission Projects endorsed in 2026 total $12.446 billion as of September 30, 2026.

         •   All projects (in engineering, routing, licensing and construction) total approximately $55.536 billion
             as of July 17, 2026.

         •   Transmission Projects energized in 2026 total approximately $595.737 million as of July 17, 2026.

         •   Transmission Projects planned to energize during the remainder of 2026 total approximately
             $6.526 billion as of July 17, 2026.

 PUBLIC   Loads Approved to Energize - Observations
         •   Of the 9,456 MW that have received Approval to Energize, ERCOT has observed a non-simultaneous monthly
             peak consumption of 4,132 MW in September 2026, which is a slight decrease since August 2026.
             – This is calculated as the sum of the maximum value for each individual load per month.
             – This value represents how much approved load ERCOT believes is now operational.

                   Total Real-Time congestion rent increased in September, with the highest congestion rent in the North and South Zones
                   • The constraint representing the loss of the 345 kV line double circuit from Willow Creek to Ramhorn Hill (overloading the 345 kV line from Parker to Hicks) primarily
                     drove congestion rent in the North Zone.
                   • The manual base case constraint on the La Palma transformer and the post-contingency constraint, representing the loss of the double circuit lines from North
                     Edinburg to Stewart and North Edinburg to Kingfisher, primarily drove congestion rent in the South Zone after the transformer was derated due to a loss of cooling
                     fans.


                    Notes:        1) Congestion rent is determined using the shadow prices and MW flows for individual constraints in SCED as well as the length in time of SCED intervals.
                                  2) The “Cross Zone” category consists of cases in which the substations on either end of the constraint are in different zones.

 PUBLIC   ERCOT identified one pricing incident, but was unable to correct prices


   Unable to Correct Prices
   A portion of ERCOT's market system network model did not update properly following a scheduled
   database load at the start of September 2, 2026. ERCOT corrected the model at 1:22 PM that day.
   From midnight until the correction, real-time prices were not calculated correctly for the affected
   meters. Because the data needed to recalculate those prices could not be accurately recreated,
   ERCOT was unable to analyze the impact on Real-Time Market prices. See Market Notice M-
   A090826-01
